lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr12Nb2Au2 (reduced formula Zr6NbAu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows all Au, Nb, and Zr centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.84 to 3.27 Å. This analysis further identifies 12-vertex coordination polyhedra around Au and Nb, each showing corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, and Zr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra that share corners and edges.
